verdicts.explanation: The 3.3 mS/cm value is the paper's own measured conductivity for the PVDF-HFP/Pyr13FSI/LiFSI GPE at a 3:1 IL-to-PVDF-HFP mass ratio, measured by EIS on an SS/GPE/SS cell. The paper gives the temperature only as 'room temperature', so a null numeric temperature is correct, and the unspecified kind and null secondary fields are all consistent with the text.
